goal: Converge safe architecture slimming, capability retrieval and decision routing, and v2 checkpoint cold-start optimization without creating a second runtime or authority.
acceptance_criteria: integrate the independently frozen A, B, and C workstreams by semantic merge with no authority duplication
run capability search and D0/D1/D2/D3 formal evaluation on one frozen integrated source
use the routing evidence to evaluate Blueprint simplification and fixed role-separation collapse without weakening reliability or safety
preserve Conversation, Knowledge, CapabilityRegistry, ProjectBlueprint, Provider, persistence, and delivery authority boundaries
finish with zero failed and zero errored integrated regression plus the required real product smokes

quality_metrics.measure: public surface and product behavior after safe slimming
quality_metrics.method: surface hashes, targeted suites, and integrated full regression

quality_metrics.measure: routing reliability, strong-model share, false escalation, and missed escalation
quality_metrics.target: preserve acceptance and critical-stop correctness while reducing unnecessary strong work
quality_metrics.method: same-case D0/D1/D2/D3 comparison on the integrated source

quality_metrics.measure: Top1, Top3, latency, candidate count, and bounded context
quality_metrics.target: no selection regression and bounded context through 1000 synthetic capabilities

quality_metrics.measure: 250k v2 checkpoint cold start against the fixed S0 baseline
quality_metrics.target: strictly faster than 37.430 seconds with correctness and fallback preserved

control: no force push or automatic PR
improvement: evidence-driven A2 simplification only after D0/D1/D2/D3
retain abstractions that materially protect reliability or authority

interface_expectations: CapabilityRegistry remains the sole capability authority and its search index is derived and rebuildable
ProjectKnowledgePack and authoritative segments remain the sole knowledge and persistence authorities
ProjectBlueprint remains unchanged until a controlled A/B proves an equivalent minimal representation
Decision routing does not become a second Agent, planner, DAG, state store, or runtime
existing v1 packs remain readable and never auto-migrate
